title: Evaluator result (Evaluator Protocol v1)
description: The outcome of one evaluator invocation. Informational: draft-07 keywords describe the shape, but validation is the hand-written check in runtime/evaluator_result.py, not a JSON-Schema library. Field naming is seeded from templates/REVIEW-RECEIPT.template.json (its `result` is `status` here).

evaluator.description: Registry name of the evaluator that produced this result.

exit.description: The wrapped checker exit code, unchanged.
